title: Supplier Terms and Conditions, Aurelian Engineering Parts (S03)
sections: Scope and Pricing
Aurelian Engineering Parts, designated as supplier S03, provides ship spares to Calder Bay Ship Management Ltd.
All prices quoted by Aurelian Engineering Parts for ship spares are unit prices as listed in the spares catalogue.
The prices for all items supplied by Aurelian Engineering Parts are expressed in US dollars and are exclusive of any discounts.
Calder Bay Ship Management Ltd shall confirm the required spares and their quantities in writing prior to placing an order with Aurelian Engineering Parts.
Aurelian Engineering Parts is responsible for ensuring that all spares supplied meet the quality and specification standards agreed upon in the purchase order.
All orders placed with Aurelian Engineering Parts must reference the applicable spares catalogue and include the specific item codes and descriptions.
Calder Bay Ship Management Ltd shall review and approve any changes to the spares catalogue prior to its implementation.
Volume Discounts
The applicable discount rate for an order is determined by the total value of the order before any discount is applied. 4% applies to orders with a total value between USD 3,000 and USD 11,999.
A discount of 9% is applicable to orders with a total value between USD 12,000 and USD 39,999. The discount is calculated on the total value of the order before discount.
A discount of 15% applies to orders with a total value of USD 40,000 or more. The discount is calculated on the total value of the order before discount.

The discount rate is applied to the total value of the order and is reflected in the invoice issued by Aurelian Engineering Parts. The discount is not cumulative and applies only to the order in question.

No additional discounts are available for multiple orders placed within the same calendar month. The discount is valid for the calendar month in which the order is placed and is subject to the terms and conditions of the purchase order.
The discount is not applicable to any order that includes items not covered by the applicable discount tier or to any order that is subject to a separate agreement.
Delivery and Incoterms
S03 sells all parts on Incoterms EXW from its Singapore warehouse, with the buyer responsible for arranging and paying for all freight and transportation costs.
The buyer is responsible for ensuring that all necessary export and import documentation is prepared and submitted in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.
S03 will not be liable for any delays or damages arising from the buyer’s failure to arrange or pay for freight, transportation, or customs clearance.
All goods are to be shipped in accordance with the buyer’s specified packaging and labeling requirements, unless otherwise agreed in writing.
S03 reserves the right to refuse shipment if the buyer fails to provide accurate and complete delivery instructions or payment confirmation.
Warranty
The warranty period for new parts supplied under S03 is 24 months from the date of delivery.
The warranty period for reconditioned parts supplied under S03 is 6 months from the date of delivery.
Calder Bay Ship Management Ltd reserves the right to inspect parts upon delivery to verify compliance with warranty terms.
In the event of a defect covered by warranty, Aurelian Engineering Parts shall replace the faulty part at no cost to Calder Bay Ship Management Ltd.
The warranty does not cover damage resulting from improper installation, misuse, or unauthorized modifications to the parts.
Expedited Orders
The expedite surcharge for S03 orders is calculated as 18% of the order value for any delivery completed faster than the catalogue lead time.
The surcharge applies to all orders that specify a delivery date earlier than the standard lead time listed in the catalogue.
The expedite surcharge is to be added to the total invoice amount and is non-negotiable.
The supplier is responsible for ensuring that expedited orders are processed and delivered within the agreed timeframe.
The customer must confirm the expedited delivery request in writing prior to placing the order.
The surcharge is applicable regardless of the reason for the expedited delivery, including but not limited to urgent operational requirements.
The supplier must provide written confirmation of the expedited delivery date and the associated surcharge upon order confirmation.
Payment and Cancellation
Payment for all goods and services supplied by Aurelian Engineering Parts shall be made in accordance with the net 60 days terms.
The buyer is required to issue payment within the net 60 days period following the date of invoice.
Payment shall be made via bank transfer to the account details provided by Aurelian Engineering Parts in writing.
Cancellation of an order must be requested in writing by the buyer prior to the commencement of production.
Aurelian Engineering Parts reserves the right to charge for any costs incurred due to cancellation of an order.
